programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義

programme.title: 紮根 #5

programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​展開由月球力量引導的史詩般的旅程看看無形的信號如何指引鯨魚和海龜沿著海洋遷徙路線,與夜鷹鳥一起穿越大陸,並觀察糞甲蟲及其他依靠月光導航的昆蟲

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義

programme.title: 紮根 #5
programme.desc: 這是令人難以置信關於一棵樹的故事,它已存活了八百多年能抵受最惡劣的環境而且昆蟲、鳥類和動物更喜歡它巨大的猢猻樹它紮根於津巴布韋南部的馬里蘭威禁獵區的大草原

programme.title: 海洋饕餮盛宴 英普
programme.desc: 前排觀看地球上最大規模的生物量遷移,即每年沿南非東海岸1000英里的沙丁魚風暴數十億條小魚倉皇躲避著饑餓的捕食者,其中包括隱秘的海豹和潛水炸彈般的塘鵝

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水

programme.title: 祕「蜜」日記 英普
programme.desc: 在蜂巢內,成千上萬的小動物朝著一個共同目標努力:群體的生存但是個別蜜蜂的生活又如何?《秘「蜜」日記》講述這個故事

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #3
programme.desc: 非洲大草原有著史詩式的景致,無論是砸頭的河馬、荷爾蒙失調的大象還是決鬥的獅子,席捲大草原的戰鬥都同樣是史詩式的

programme.title: 肯亞野生日記 #1
programme.desc: 尼華保育區正在努力讓大象由肯雅山經過桑布魯國家公園回到野外他們還創造了一個大象禁區,試圖恢復受損的生態系統無線電跟蹤項圈用於幫助環保學家更好地瞭解大象的需求,並觀察牠們是否正返回棲息地

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #1
programme.desc: 瞭解世上最大的火山島,一個孤獨而崎嶇不平的地方,蒸汽散逸,水花四濺,每天都有新土地誕生且看冰火交融如何打造地球上最強大的地質島嶼

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #2
programme.desc: 遊覽從前由冰雕鑿而成,現在則是由火山建構的島嶼大約150萬年前,一塊冰地從北而下並覆蓋了整片土地時至今日,巨大的冰川仍繼續一邊雕刻著海洋懸崖,一邊砍伐山脈

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #3
programme.desc: 走進芬迪灣洶湧的水域瞭解這個東岸生態系統如何維持眾多生物,當中包括成千上萬的海鳥,世上最快的捕食者,以及複雜的無脊椎動物網絡

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #4
programme.desc: 沿著大不列顛島的西海岸,世上最長的無間斷步道穿越超過800英里的壯麗景色威爾斯海岸的多樣化景觀簡直是地質瑰寶

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #5
programme.desc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟它被大西洋、莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #6
programme.desc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地

programme.title: 紮根 #1
programme.desc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壯麗的駱駝刺樹這棵相思樹已經在此屹立了兩個世紀在這片乾旱的地貌中,這棵駱駝刺樹是大大小小生物的避難所善於交際的織布鳥、綠豆象甲蟲和各種哺乳類動物在喀拉哈里活用這棵標誌性的樹

programme.title: 紮根 #2
programme.desc: 這是備受喜愛的香腸樹的浪漫故事博茨瓦納東北角的塞林達保護區面臨艱難的一年它十分乾旱,雨季還有幾個月才來到在如此具有挑戰性的期間,許多鳥類和動物依靠香腸樹來維持生計

programme.title: 紮根 #3
programme.desc: 索特潘斯山脈的高山地雨林中生長出巨大的奧特尼夸香槐樹這是一個講述了這棵巨大的樹如何在她的枝梢中提供居所、飼養和庇護一眾動植物的故事

programme.title: 紮根 #4
programme.desc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境

programme.title: 紮根 #5
programme.desc: 這是令人難以置信關於一棵樹的故事,它已存活了八百多年能抵受最惡劣的環境而且昆蟲、鳥類和動物更喜歡它巨大的猢猻樹它紮根於津巴布韋南部的馬里蘭威禁獵區的大草原

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰
programme.desc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王一起為群雄的速度、獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #1
programme.desc: 來到澳洲南部水域,展開一場具挑戰性的追蹤任務,並揭示鯊魚的食物來源和他們聚集於覓食熱點的原因團隊之後一路向北,追蹤虎鯊、公牛鯊和錘頭鯊,並為他們其中一員裝上360度的背鰭攝像鏡頭

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #2
programme.desc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #3
programme.desc: 與位處北方的科學家團隊一起熬夜,他們嘗試為一隻公牛鯊裝上追蹤儀,看看這頭夜貓子入夜後有何行蹤然後與南方團隊一起潛入80米深的海底,並嘗試為一條雌性大白鯊裝上衛星追蹤器

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #4
programme.desc: 跟隨北方研究團隊窺探鯊魚的社群層級結構,他們正在研究年輕的黑鰭鯊如何學習社交和生存技能然後與南方團隊會合,一同前往彩虹海灘,他們渴望目睹沙虎鯊最難以捉摸的行為:交配

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #5
programme.desc: 探索澳洲超級鯊魚大道的盡頭,了解南方的格林利島是否大白鯊遷徙路線的中途站,然後尋找北方牛鯊與生活在較冷氣候的表親,以及他們之間的基因聯繫證據

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #6
programme.desc: 跟隨南方團隊測試新的追蹤鯊魚技術和工具,可望減少在熱門浮潛地點的鯊魚攻擊然後與北方團隊一起追蹤牛鯊;科學家們希望幫助當地游泳者避開即將分娩的母牛鯊

programme.title: 奇異地球 #5 英普
programme.desc: 一窺大自然中最兇猛的鬥士,牠們以暴力來爭奪所需觀看肉食的波爾夏蜘蛛如何吞噬對手,揭開可愛無尾熊的嗜血一面,並捲入長頸鹿之間一場激烈的頸項對決

programme.title: 奇異地球 #6 英普
programme.desc: 深入暸解地球上最強悍的動物幫派,見證野外求生的真正力量追蹤一群獵食中的蝗蟲,觀察邊蛸如何埋伏獵物,並拜會一群已培養出嗜血習性的雀鳥

programme.title: 雪豹獵奇 #2
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​跟隨丹與他的團隊,一同在「老兄」的領地中嗅探、追蹤,他們懷疑雌性雪豹在雪豹族群中的角色,可能遠比先前想像的更加關鍵、更具影響力當丹意外發現一群雪豹聚集的反常現象時,對雪豹行為的既有研究與認知也因此受到衝擊與挑戰

programme.title: 動物知心友 #5
programme.desc: 一起去看看樹懶艾莎的近況佩德羅把自己的人生奉獻給照顧牠,因為牠在一次墜落意外後癱瘓了了解為什麼狼索爾願意讓牠的人類夥伴史提夫加入自己的族群,接著再看看克莉絲汀和博如何讓浣熊水晶的生活變得更加方便自在

programme.title: 動物知心友 #6
programme.desc: 跟水獺奧茲以及他的教練萊絲莉一起學習游泳,接著看看佩特羅內爾如何贏得犀牛孤兒莉莉的信任,牠曾因偷獵者而受到創傷和老鼠科比一起嗅出地雷,並和雙髻鯊蓋婭一起自由潛水

programme.title: 紮根 #4
programme.desc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境

programme.title: 月球野性面 #3

programme.title: 金伯利:澳洲的狂野西境 #1
programme.desc: ​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​與小袋鼠一起躲避長滿鱗片與覆滿羽毛的危險威脅,觀察庫拉馬那蜥蜴為了爭奪配偶而激烈交戰,並與剛孵化的鱷魚幼體一同進食在雨季來臨之際,勇闖危險的急流,理解一條在地河流在文化層面與生物層面上的重要意義

programme.title: 紮根 #5

programme.title: 王者爭霸 #3
programme.desc: 非洲大草原有著史詩式的景致,無論是砸頭的河馬、荷爾蒙失調的大象還是決鬥的獅子,席捲大草原的戰鬥都同樣是史詩式的

programme.title: 肯亞野生日記 #1
programme.desc: 尼華保育區正在努力讓大象由肯雅山經過桑布魯國家公園回到野外他們還創造了一個大象禁區,試圖恢復受損的生態系統無線電跟蹤項圈用於幫助環保學家更好地瞭解大象的需求,並觀察牠們是否正返回棲息地

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #1
programme.desc: 瞭解世上最大的火山島,一個孤獨而崎嶇不平的地方,蒸汽散逸,水花四濺,每天都有新土地誕生且看冰火交融如何打造地球上最強大的地質島嶼

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #2
programme.desc: 遊覽從前由冰雕鑿而成,現在則是由火山建構的島嶼大約150萬年前,一塊冰地從北而下並覆蓋了整片土地時至今日,巨大的冰川仍繼續一邊雕刻著海洋懸崖,一邊砍伐山脈

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #3
programme.desc: 走進芬迪灣洶湧的水域瞭解這個東岸生態系統如何維持眾多生物,當中包括成千上萬的海鳥,世上最快的捕食者,以及複雜的無脊椎動物網絡

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #4
programme.desc: 沿著大不列顛島的西海岸,世上最長的無間斷步道穿越超過800英里的壯麗景色威爾斯海岸的多樣化景觀簡直是地質瑰寶

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #5
programme.desc: 愛爾蘭雖小,但卻充滿奇蹟它被大西洋、莫赫懸崖及至非凡的巨人堤道圍繞,這土地一直被水力和強烈的地質力量所塑造和重塑

programme.title: 迷忘國度 #6
programme.desc: 溫哥華島的野生太平洋海岸是卑詩省西海岸的一片古老而崎嶇的風貌從久遠高山冰川的冰封山峰到加拿大濃霧蓋頂的唯一雨林,它是北美最潮濕的地方,這片原始的棲息地,既是太平洋的命脈,亦是大自然與人文精神共存之地

programme.title: 紮根 #1
programme.desc: 在喀拉哈里南部的草原上,有一棵壯麗的駱駝刺樹這棵相思樹已經在此屹立了兩個世紀在這片乾旱的地貌中,這棵駱駝刺樹是大大小小生物的避難所善於交際的織布鳥、綠豆象甲蟲和各種哺乳類動物在喀拉哈里活用這棵標誌性的樹

programme.title: 紮根 #2
programme.desc: 這是備受喜愛的香腸樹的浪漫故事博茨瓦納東北角的塞林達保護區面臨艱難的一年它十分乾旱,雨季還有幾個月才來到在如此具有挑戰性的期間,許多鳥類和動物依靠香腸樹來維持生計

programme.title: 紮根 #3
programme.desc: 索特潘斯山脈的高山地雨林中生長出巨大的奧特尼夸香槐樹這是一個講述了這棵巨大的樹如何在她的枝梢中提供居所、飼養和庇護一眾動植物的故事

programme.title: 紮根 #4
programme.desc: 納馬夸岩無花果樹紮根於南非納馬夸蘭的岩石山坡上它是最終的倖存者,能夠承受每年不斷上升的溫度和越來越少的降雨量這等無情的環境

programme.title: 紮根 #5
programme.desc: 這是令人難以置信關於一棵樹的故事,它已存活了八百多年能抵受最惡劣的環境而且昆蟲、鳥類和動物更喜歡它巨大的猢猻樹它紮根於津巴布韋南部的馬里蘭威禁獵區的大草原

programme.title: 鯊王爭霸戰
programme.desc: 見證大白鯊群英的終極戰鬥!科學家們嘗試從新西蘭海岸外的100多條大白鯊中,挑選出領頭的鯊王一起為群雄的速度、獵食技能和無比勇氣而喝采

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #1
programme.desc: 來到澳洲南部水域,展開一場具挑戰性的追蹤任務,並揭示鯊魚的食物來源和他們聚集於覓食熱點的原因團隊之後一路向北,追蹤虎鯊、公牛鯊和錘頭鯊,並為他們其中一員裝上360度的背鰭攝像鏡頭

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #2
programme.desc: 沿著大堡礁追蹤一條懷孕的鯊魚,看看她能否帶領科學家團隊找到隱秘的生產地然後到南部海岸尋找求偶中的鯊魚,並見證一條非常害羞的雌性巨鯊如何發現愛情

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #3
programme.desc: 與位處北方的科學家團隊一起熬夜,他們嘗試為一隻公牛鯊裝上追蹤儀,看看這頭夜貓子入夜後有何行蹤然後與南方團隊一起潛入80米深的海底,並嘗試為一條雌性大白鯊裝上衛星追蹤器

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #4
programme.desc: 跟隨北方研究團隊窺探鯊魚的社群層級結構,他們正在研究年輕的黑鰭鯊如何學習社交和生存技能然後與南方團隊會合,一同前往彩虹海灘,他們渴望目睹沙虎鯊最難以捉摸的行為:交配

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #5
programme.desc: 探索澳洲超級鯊魚大道的盡頭,了解南方的格林利島是否大白鯊遷徙路線的中途站,然後尋找北方牛鯊與生活在較冷氣候的表親,以及他們之間的基因聯繫證據

programme.title: 超級鯊魚大道 #6
programme.desc: 跟隨南方團隊測試新的追蹤鯊魚技術和工具,可望減少在熱門浮潛地點的鯊魚攻擊然後與北方團隊一起追蹤牛鯊;科學家們希望幫助當地游泳者避開即將分娩的母牛鯊

programme.title: 李小龍:戰士之道
programme.desc: 李小龍,荷里活電影的標誌性人物,武術先驅,但最重要的是,他是一位朋友《武者之路》全面審視,由最親近的人講述李小龍的傳奇

programme.title: 阿姆斯壯
programme.desc: 《阿姆斯壯》戲劇性、感人且富有洞察力地講述尼爾岩士唐最完整的人生故事—從他在俄亥俄州鄉村的童年到他首次登月—以及伴隨而來非他所願的名人地位

programme.title: 碧昂絲:鄉村音樂女王
programme.desc: 關注碧昂絲諾爾斯卡特的人生和事業,從她早年擔任組合「天命真女」主唱到現在的單飛生涯探討這位超級巨星多年來的音樂風格和靈感是如何演變的

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #8
programme.desc: 安斯利來到摩洛哥,但他沒有去馬拉喀什或卡薩布蘭加,而是去了豐富多彩、混亂而夢幻的費茲雜亂無序的麥地那是世界遺產,也是通往另一個時代的門戶

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #9
programme.desc: 安斯利到訪檳島首都喬治敦,馬來西亞人發現這個沉迷美食的國家中最好的街頭食品

programme.title: 街頭美食通 #10
programme.desc: 安斯利在美食之旅的最後一站到訪問約旦的安曼,那是來自伊拉克、黎巴嫩、巴勒斯坦和敘利亞中東一族叫作家的交匯處

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #2
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索人類有史以來面臨的最大存亡風險之一的未來- 一個生化威脅從病毒到人造流行病和合成生化武器,科技正加速人造威脅的風險

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #3
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》探索一個近未來,人工智能統治著地球和我們人工智能將伴隨我們一生,並帶來人類史上所面臨的最大存亡風險

programme.title: 生存邊緣 #1
programme.desc: 《生存邊緣》檢視全球生物圈所面臨的存亡威脅,以及對地球和奧特亞羅瓦(紐西蘭)的未來代表著甚麼

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #1
programme.desc: 準備好迎接一場史詩般的紐約美食大探險吧!賈斯汀(Justine)來到 Russ Daughters 品嚐招牌貝果,沉浸在德卡爾布市場(DeKalb Market)充滿活力的熱鬧氛圍中,並大口享用經典的紐約切片披薩這為終極的美食冒險拉開了激動人心且風味十足的序幕!

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #2
programme.desc: 味蕾之旅大爆發!賈斯汀探索了美國烹飪學院(Culinary Institute),在 Essies 餐廳品嚐了融合加勒比海與美國南方風味的大膽創意料理,並買了香甜的義大利奶油甜餡煎餅卷(cannolis)在風景如畫的白脫牛奶瀑布(Buttermilk Falls)野餐後,她前往傳奇的 Moose

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #3
programme.desc: 一場狂野的市場之旅正等著您!賈斯汀一頭栽進鹽城市場(Salt City Market),在奧農達加湖(Onondaga Lake)湖畔烹調墨西哥捲餅,並大啖煙燻風味的 Dinosaur BBQ 烤肉最後,她在風景優美的卡南代瓜(Canandaigua)享用黏糊糊的花生醬烤棉花糖巧克力夾心餅(sm

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #4
programme.desc: 美食驚喜持續不斷!賈斯汀將當地 Living Roots 酒莊的葡萄酒與豐盛的義式玉米糊(polenta)完美搭配,欣賞令人嘆為觀止的尼加拉瀑布(Niagara Falls),並造訪指標性的 Anchor Bar,大口品嚐最正宗的水牛城辣雞翅!純粹的美味與令人驚豔的美景在此完美交會

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #5
programme.desc: 賈斯汀在水牛城大啖經典的烤牛肉午餐,隨後乘船啟航,前往壯麗的千島群島(1000 Islands)和博爾特城堡(Boldt Castle)!在風景如畫的水域沿岸一邊烹飪、一邊探索,最後她在奢華的薩加莫爾度假村(Sagamore Resort)為這難忘的一天畫上休止符

programme.title: 紐約美食指南 #6
programme.desc: 盛大的壓軸好戲火熱登場!賈斯汀在 Toad Hill 楓糖農場搭配新鮮糖漿製作了蘋果煎餅,接著大啖薩拉托加(Saratoga)炸雞,最後在 River Market Bar and Kitchen 享用了一頓令人難忘的最終盛宴,為她這場史詩般的紐約冒險帶來最完美的加冕!

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #1
programme.desc: 班的美食故事之旅從南方深處開展,他在當地瞭解到為何羊肉如此美味他認識到最早出產松露的先驅,又乘坐直升機在菲奧德蘭國家公園尋找馬鹿

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #2
programme.desc: 班到北地大區旅行並瞭解當地的紅酒他發現一個花生農場,遇到種熱帶木瓜的人,又結識一班以前所未有方式培育紐西蘭黃尾鰤的科學家

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #3
programme.desc: 蘆筍當造 - 班挑選3個品種他遇到一位農民,瞭解到穀飼牛的好處班追隨注重自耕蔬果的「土壤姐妹」運動

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #4
programme.desc: 班參觀可持續養殖的綠殼青口養殖場,又參觀花生醬工廠他到坎特伯雷見一個鴕鳥農夫,並第一次烹煮鴕鳥!

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #5
programme.desc: 班遇見一位琴酒釀造者和一位義大利肉店商,並讚揚一位致力於永續農產原則的釀酒師班擠羊奶,並瞭解下一代農夫如何打造多元化業務

programme.title: 紐西蘭美食故事 3 #6
programme.desc: 班體驗製作芝士的藝術他遇到一位甜椒生產商並瞭解洋蔥的起源

programme.title: 美國總統錄 #4

programme.desc: Ali the elephant at Shoushan Zoo, carries the childhood memories of many children, both young and old Although he is now 49 years old, he is still energetic under the care of the keepers Once the new zoo is completed, the public will be able to see "Ali" again When the caregiver helps Ali take a shower, Ali will take the opportunity to replenish his body with water; sometimes he will step on water in the pool and use his nose to enjoy the fun of playing in the water nThere are currently only three African elephants in Taiwan In addition to Ali, the other two are in the Taipei City Zoo Because African elephants are endangered wild animals, their import and export are strictly controlled If these three elephants die in the future, Taiwan may no longer see any African elephants Shoushan Zoo vows to take good care of "Ali" so that "Ali's" heartwarming story can continue, and shoulder the mission of life education, so that everyone's visit to the Shoushan Zoo is the starting point of happy memories In addition to Ali the elephant, Shoushan Zoo currently has two white rhinos, male "Xiqi" from the Taipei City Zoo and female "Baby" who was bred naturally in the zoo nWhite rhino "Xiqi" was loaned to Shoushan Zoo in hope that he could successfully mate with the female white rhino "Baby" to raise the white rhino population

programme.desc: The suicide of a woman shocked an entire village It jolted an entire province, and word of her death even reached the imperial court Upon hearing of the reasons behind this woman’s untimely death, the emperor decreed a magnificent arch be built in her memory, earning her family, her village and her province an honor of the highest degree These beautiful arches, which dot China’s scenery, are the culmination of a culture founded on the remembrance of those who achieved a higher moral status than the rest of society, those who were chaste and remained pure, even in their deaths Discover China passes on the story of Memorial Arches

programme.desc: At the turn of the century, a Child-Emperor ascended to the throne of the Chinese Qing Dynasty Emperor Pu-Yi’s Reign was short lived and mired with treason, corruption and external influences After abdicating his throne, Pu Yi knew his days in the imperial palace were numbered Questions of his survival as a commoner began to trouble his mind Upon looking at the wealth of priceless artifacts collected over 500 years of imperial reign, Pu Yi began plotting ways to smuggle these riches out However, Pu Yi was not alone Discover China brings you the story of how the precious treasures of the Imperial City disappeared from the capital palace, and where some reside today

programme.desc: A Swiss Italian television crew was in Kabul in the days leading up to the surrender and was able to document the growing anguish of a society that feels the end of a hope cultivated for twenty years Social, civil and democratic achievements, especially those made by women, are being swept away It is also the starting point for a reflection on the fight against terrorism

programme.title: The Huddle
programme.desc: Though separated by a stretch of sea, Glasgow and Belfast share elements of political, sporting and religious culture rooted in the difficult, unresolved events faced by the Irish community during the twentieth century The Huddle tells the stories of two Irish communities brought together by a devotion to the Celtic Football Club, and a shared faith in football Exploring the contradictions between two cities facing radical ideological divides yet brought together by full stadiums, these are the interwoven and personal accounts of journalists, musicians, political militants, IRA fighters—all united by their love of football—on what it means to be Irish

programme.title: Oh My God!
programme.desc: It is the fastest growing Christian church on earth and here The Holy Spirit truly flows Host Tevya joins the boisterous celebration of worship at a Pentecostal Revival church where speaking in tongues, writhing on the floor and spiritual healing are all part of the faith experience He travels to Bible camp to learn how young Pentecostals really feel the spirit, get baptized and how they pray for Tevya's soul

programme.title: Turning a Blind Eye
programme.desc: In October 2019 an unthinkable tragedy hit the peaceful village of Jura in Switzerland Christophe Keller slit his wife Mélanie's throat before cutting his own The crime shocked the whole country What had happened between this couple, living a seemingly ordinary life with their three children? Each year, nearly 90,000 women are killed by their partner or ex-partner throughout the world Could more have been done to save Mélanie?

programme.title: A Gentleman Thief
programme.desc: Vincenzo Pipino is a thief, he was convicted and has done over 25 years in prison both in Italy and in the rest of Europe and has expiated his faults The documentary tells the story of this last gentleman thief

programme.title: The Silent Scream
programme.desc: Since thirty years the data on the glaciers melting are truly alarming There are men who have dedicated most of their lives to glaciers, photographing, measuring and monitoring them This documentary collects their testimonies, bringing more awareness about the current state of glaciers and our mountains

programme.title: Messages from the End of the World
programme.desc: The documentary describes the dramatic consequences of the climate change in the Arctic zone Thanks to the Swiss Arctic Project five young people have been navigating for three weeks through hostile and beautiful landscapes up to the North They have documented the signs of global warming and raise the new generation’s awareness through socialnnetworks

programme.desc: 麥特戴蒙回歸,再次飾演傑森伯恩,保羅葛林格拉斯執導的神鬼認證:傑森包恩也將繼續上演驚險刺激的續集伯恩被迫重出江湖,與艾莉西亞·維坎德,文森特·卡塞爾等眾多明星聯袂出擊,共同面對新的危機

programme.title: 天崩地裂

programme.title: 醉後末日
programme.desc: 在 醉後末日中,西蒙·佩格與尼克·弗羅斯特再次攜手展開史詩般的酒吧巡禮,卻意外捲入一場關乎人類未來的生死戰導演埃德加·賴特(Edgar Wright)帶來充滿懷舊情懷,幽默喜劇與科幻刺激元素的獨特觀影體驗

programme.title: 美國殺人魔

programme.desc: 科學家研究人類生殖,過程中有驚人發現,當人類的卵子受精的那一瞬間,卵子會爆發 超過100億個鋅離快速產生一道「細胞閃光」到底何謂生命?吳宣倫博士為大家展開生命的奧秘。

programme.title: 靈修早晨
programme.desc: 每天早晨透過詩歌安靜心靈,從牧者及嘉賓的分享學習《聖經》中的真理,讓觀眾由淺入深認識信仰,默想《聖經》教導。

programme.title: 「創世電視福音主日」-不由你不信之從萬物創造到深邃的愛
programme.desc: 「超闊銀幕震撼影像」遇上「意想不到又大眾化的福音主題」,加上「誠意的款待」會產生極致的「福音體驗」。梁明彪博士分享上帝如何從人類各器官的精密構造,看到上帝創造是多麼奇妙偉大,每個人的出生就是一場最嚴謹的監製,原來正常的生命就是一場神蹟。在領受上帝創造恩典之時,明白祂在創造過程對人的慈愛和關懷。

programme.title: 你是主角
programme.desc: 有人說,人生是一場戲,在人生的過程中,尋找有時、碰壁有時、迷失有時、覺醒有時,說真的,這些起承轉合比真正的電影情節更精彩,每一個「你」,都是天父特別設計的人生劇本主角。 今天,我們的世界充滿了末世風情,醉生夢死、迷失自我了結生命的悲劇每天上演,創世電視藉100個見證故事挽救生命,100位來自世界各地

programme.title: 聖地流動教室-以色列破謎之旅
programme.desc: 通曉中西方歷史、文學、藝術、民間傳說的學者吳宗文牧師,以及主持梁藝齡,透過鏡頭帶著電視觀眾,去到聖地各站遊歷,呈現出新舊約的《聖經》典故、歷史文獻的記載、相關的猶太傳說和傳統習俗,而更重要是從耶穌和初期信徒的記載,帶出人生的重要特質,助你成就非凡人生。

programme.title: 今日説法
programme.desc: 《今日說法》是一檔日播法治欄目,秉持「點滴記錄中國法治進程」的理念,以「重在普法,監督執法,促進立法、服務百姓」為宗旨,採用「以案說法、大眾參與、專家點評」的節目樣式進行普法宣傳,被譽「中國人的法制午餐」。節目前半部分呈現記者深入基層採訪的真實案例,後半部分由演播室中的主持人和嘉賓對節目進行點評,體現節目品質和社會價值。

高朋滿座#235粵
programme.desc: 喜跟慶到雲南作義診，欲選出新一任高家「話事人」，竟讓義當選。義大灑金錢滿足眾人要求，花指義此舉將使高家陷入赤字，但義依然故我。朋要悅了解溢的工作情況，悅與義發現溢遭上司欺負，義為此聘請溢到藥房工作。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#6粵普PG
programme.desc: 小石帶著溫柔跟蹤傅宗書，要給他一個教訓，之後二人路經市集，聽到有人落水，小石立刻下水救人。落水的人是方應看，他得知溫柔的身分後，表明曾與她結下了姻親。溫柔對應看輕佻的態度很不屑，但應看卻對她很有興趣。

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
阿媽教落食平D粵
programme.desc: 購入波士頓龍蝦，連同多款配料及酥皮，焗出濃味的西湯「酥皮龍蝦湯」，平價煮出好滋味。另一道西式「蝦小菜」，是將煎過的琵琶蝦放入法國牛油軟包之中，味道媲美龍蝦！將蘿蔔絲水份釋出，加入麵粉、雞蛋及調味拌勻後炸，再灑櫻花蝦乾，便做出懷舊的「蘿蔔餅」。用猛火炸攋尿蝦是廚房常識，想做「避風塘攋尿蝦」還需甚麼調味料？用酥皮麵線捲着虎蝦烤成的「奇妙金絲蝦」，講求的技巧眾多，快快抄下重點！

programme.title: 航向未來粵
programme.desc: 運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

programme.title: 流行都市粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 胸椎弧度一旦超過五十度便會界定為寒背，並可分為功能性與結構性兩類。脊醫除了細說兩者的不同成因外，更提到嚴重功能性寒背有可能威脅心肺健康。脊醫還以「先放鬆、後強化」為準則，示範相關運動。兩位女生早前參與世界技能大賽，分別於櫥窗設計及西點製作項目勇奪優異獎章，她們到來暢談賽前準備與比賽點滴。二人透露曾受賽場溫度影響，全靠臨場應變化解危機。「睇餸食飯」，廚藝專家傅季馨帶來「脆脆紫菜鯪魚餅」，香口惹味。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 張曦雯夥同梁偉灝，徐榮和譚詠儀組隊，從「拍檔聯乘」啟動對壘，徐榮演戲前原來曾是廚師！檢視兩隊餐單，評判幟哥認為菜式相對簡單？看到詠儀製作「話梅蓮藕烤麩」時，把烤麩上脆漿油炸，眾評判即有所期待。曦雯隊的頭盤「慢煮三文魚流心溫泉蛋」，控制溫度是關鍵！主菜方面，徐榮隊巧製「松葉蟹戒米飯」夠健康，他處理「炒飯」的刀法、拋鑊亦有板有眼。曦雯隊的煙燻白鴿胸利梳多飯，鴿胸經燻、煎、焗三重步驟，幟哥提到仍有缺點？

programme.title: 大帥哥#11粵PG
programme.desc: 狄奇為籌措軍費徵收人頭稅，民怨沸騰！此時少帥突然失蹤，狄奇心知是誰搞鬼，接納沅婉建議退稅。狄奇一計不成，決定舉辦盆菜宴，向鎮民痛陳利弊，游說軍隊攻打祿豐鎮……細龜、佘南互相不肯撤離祿豐鎮，英俊提供一個雙贏的方法。馬炭、羅義討論攻鎮策略，被落蘆批評得體無完膚，聲稱只有一個方法才能成功。出戰前夕，沅婉要求加入大軍任軍醫，狄奇斷然拒絕，安排三女各司其職。大軍出發前，狄奇發現三女喬裝潛入軍隊……

programme.title: 方德證券獨家呈現:交易現場粵 及 方德證券獨家呈現:交易先機粵
櫻桃小丸子粵日
programme.desc: 英叔生日將至，花輪同學詢問小丸子意見，最後決定大家一起為英叔慶生，給他一個驚喜。小丸子是龜族的一份子，為了不再讓其他動物小看龜族，小丸子等龜族毅然求教龜爺爺，並向兔族作出挑戰。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 「WORKOUT 2GETHER」，這集兩節訓練需要用上不同工具，集齊小健身球及兩個水樽，就可開始做熱身。保持V-Sit姿勢或躺下後抬起腳，再推移健身球，有助強化核心肌力。接下來的動作更具挑戰，雙手雙腳踏實在地，抬起臀部前後移動的同時，也不能讓放於腹部的健身球掉下來！第二輪要大家在指定距離之間完成鍛練，並以水樽作標示。向左右跳步、抬腳伸向不同方向等動作都只靠單腳支撐，好好訓練平衡力與穩定度。

programme.title: 秘密的偶像公主粵日
programme.desc: 又來到一年一度的校舍清潔比賽。朱莉亞與詠瑠雖為室友，卻礙於性格迴異，經常吵架。於是，她倆便乘着這個機會，在比賽中盡情較量。另一方面，陽葵與美月作為兩支隊伍的隊長，竟將對決丟到一旁，和睦地一起打掃。

programme.title: 財經新聞粵
programme.desc: 緊貼市況，逢交易日下午5時50分報道當日本港和外圍股市行情，以及重點財經新聞。

programme.title: 新聞掏寶粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 現代社會人浮於事，年輕人想找工作絕對不易，政府和社福機構都為年輕人舉行培訓，甚至幫他們找僱主試工，成效有多大？新聞掏寶和大家重溫1999年專題。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 宏利保險呈獻：灣區零距離粵
航向未來粵
programme.desc: 運輸及物流局積極推動本港的海空聯運，節目《航向未來》由星級藝員吳偉豪、郭柏妍擔綱演出，並飾演初到海運前線的實習生，透過實況情節，介紹當局如何精準高效地協調貨船泊進港口後，把船上貨物經香港轉運出海，繼而運往世界各地，同時為國際航運業綠色減碳出力。

programme.title: 滙豐Premier Elite呈獻：《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》粵 及 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 金融市場瞬息萬變，加上科技發展日新月異，如何影響投資市場？《滙豐Premier Elite財富滙談》，雲集不同行業專家，剖析市場趨勢，講解金融、投資及理財等話題，務求做到深入淺出，聚焦分析不同議題，為大家捕捉市場先機。

programme.title: 黃道益活絡油呈獻：愛．回家之三代同糖#77粵
programme.desc: 朱基因龔喜一句話，不惜潛入外國博物館盜取寶物，成了國際通輯犯；龔喜卻習以為常，毫不擔心。龔喜得悉前男友Steven來港註冊結婚，遂與嘉冰前往搞破壞。嘉冰等人因此得知龔喜曾遭他陷害入獄，朱基不惜身陷囹圄相救。Steven趁朱基出埠處理盜寶風波，派人綁架龔喜與嘉冰，勢要與龔喜一刀兩斷，並道出當年分手及龔喜入獄的真相。朱基趕至救人，揭穿「真相的另一面」；混亂間，Steven向朱基擲飛刀，龔喜飛撲擋刀……

programme.title: 保誠保險呈獻：玫瑰戰爭#13粵PG
programme.desc: 無雙與菲雅達成協議，聯手調查行跡可疑的綺雲。無雙向雲生提出合資建設串流平台與實體影城，並以競選電影總會主席為條件。雲生命鳳儀蒐集現任主席黑材料逼其退選，綺雲深感地位危機，二女針鋒相對。菲雅順利親近綺雲，無雙付酬讓素希中止任務，沒料素希另有想法。鳳儀以生日會爭奪雲生身旁的女主人地位，並刻意支開綺雲……德龍為阻止寶兒與父親相認，竟在鳳儀的生日會上鬧事。綺雲終返港，卻沒有前往生日會……

programme.title: 豐隆旅遊保險呈獻：跟風旅行團粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 節目組預備了三段百萬級點擊影片，讓如風猜數字及排序。愛好醬油蟹的如風輕易吃掉桌上四隻蟹，得知食店採放題制，即刻要追加！她聽到價錢，更加嘩一聲！商場內有個動物園，如風嘗試接近園內多類動物，甚至準備餵食，但她似乎沒甚麼「動物緣」。環境甚普通的連鎖炸雞店，卻被網民封為韓國三大炸雞店？如風嚐過招牌「薯仔炸雞」後，大為改觀，連幕後人員都幾乎忘記還有另一款炸雞要介紹！這集還有如風私心推介的「稀有包包收藏庫」。

programme.title: 武則天#34粵普
programme.desc: 世民設局試探媚娘是否坦白李牧身分，她為護李牧偷燒卷宗，終令世民失望。媚娘發現李牧背負血仇，求楊妃安排二人離宮。

programme.title: 娛樂頭條粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
programme.desc: 節目主要以當日的娛樂新聞作重點，讓你瞬間掌握影視娛樂圈動態和最新消息，並以「娛樂大事件」、「搶閘頭條」、「出爐猛料」等為主題作頭條新聞式報道。

programme.title: 晚間新聞粵
programme.desc: 報道本地、兩岸、國際重要新聞以及體育消息，讓你洞悉各地大事及體壇動向。

programme.title: 農本方參苓白朮散呈獻:天氣報告粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
騙中傳奇#19粵
programme.desc: 寶兒為了和珅的一萬萬兩，要脅忠正交出神像。忠正佈下騙局令和珅帶走假神像，豈料寶兒與和珅反佈局，取得真神像。忠正入宮向嘉慶請罪，玉麟喝下「絕情酒」，除下忠正牙人身份，免嘉慶將他殺頭；和珅向嘉慶暗示忠正已投靠己方。和珅向忠正說出玉麟已喝下毒酒，解藥在他手上，忠正惟有照珅計劃行事。九斤二被和珅手下追殺，誤進寶兒房間，向寶兒道出愛之真義，寶兒聽罷反往和珅房間去。晨光初現，忠正催促和珅前往大殿。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 宏福苑大火一周年，市民前往該區獻花悼念。某中學發生偷拍裙底事件，校方卻未依當局指引即時報警，女生家長感不滿！某屋苑疑用老鼠藥或老鼠板滅鼠，卻意外令雀鳥死亡，居民批評做法，管理處卻推卸責任？此外，附近沙灘亦有亂擺老鼠藥誤毒雀鳥情況。繼續報道布偶貓妮妮事故的進展，告密者公開涉事診所關鍵錄音後收律師信，貓主網上批評帖文也遭刪除，懷疑有人意圖遮掩事件。診所真正負責人受訪回應，稱錯信懷疑冒充獸醫執刀的護士？

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 胸椎弧度一旦超過五十度便會界定為寒背，並可分為功能性與結構性兩類。脊醫除了細說兩者的不同成因外，更提到嚴重功能性寒背有可能威脅心肺健康。脊醫還以「先放鬆、後強化」為準則，示範相關運動。兩位女生早前參與世界技能大賽，分別於櫥窗設計及西點製作項目勇奪優異獎章，她們到來暢談賽前準備與比賽點滴。二人透露曾受賽場溫度影響，全靠臨場應變化解危機。「睇餸食飯」，廚藝專家傅季馨帶來「脆脆紫菜鯪魚餅」，香口惹味。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 張曦雯夥同梁偉灝，徐榮和譚詠儀組隊，從「拍檔聯乘」啟動對壘，徐榮演戲前原來曾是廚師！檢視兩隊餐單，評判幟哥認為菜式相對簡單？看到詠儀製作「話梅蓮藕烤麩」時，把烤麩上脆漿油炸，眾評判即有所期待。曦雯隊的頭盤「慢煮三文魚流心溫泉蛋」，控制溫度是關鍵！主菜方面，徐榮隊巧製「松葉蟹戒米飯」夠健康，他處理「炒飯」的刀法、拋鑊亦有板有眼。曦雯隊的煙燻白鴿胸利梳多飯，鴿胸經燻、煎、焗三重步驟，幟哥提到仍有缺點？

programme.title: 大帥哥#11粵PG
programme.desc: 狄奇為籌措軍費徵收人頭稅，民怨沸騰！此時少帥突然失蹤，狄奇心知是誰搞鬼，接納沅婉建議退稅。狄奇一計不成，決定舉辦盆菜宴，向鎮民痛陳利弊，游說軍隊攻打祿豐鎮……細龜、佘南互相不肯撤離祿豐鎮，英俊提供一個雙贏的方法。馬炭、羅義討論攻鎮策略，被落蘆批評得體無完膚，聲稱只有一個方法才能成功。出戰前夕，沅婉要求加入大軍任軍醫，狄奇斷然拒絕，安排三女各司其職。大軍出發前，狄奇發現三女喬裝潛入軍隊……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#235粵

programme.title: Do姐有問題粵

programme.title: 流行都市粵 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 牙周病為何無法根治？牙醫指此症因清潔不當讓牙菌膜積聚所致，如嚴重會令牙肉與牙骨流失，並無法自然回復狀態。牙醫強調，牙周病或會影響身體其他地方的血管、增加認知障礙風險等。除了治療資訊，牙醫亦細說相關徵兆及預防方法。掌中木偶是非遺項目之一，有學校將它與中國歷史融合並向學生推廣。副校長概述木偶的製作過程，同來的學生分享學習過程苦與樂，還即席示範簡單的木偶動作。「睇餸食飯」，Annie奉上「話梅花雕蝦」。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 徐榮與曦雯在「五分鐘速煮」，分別帶來薑蔥魚雲、芝士煙肉燒生蠔，呈現中、西滋味。徐榮的家常魚菜式獲不俗評價，唯獨下調味料時有小失誤；曦雯的出品卻令幟哥不敢品嚐？詠儀、偉灝各自奉上的「上湯龍蝦伊麵」與「西班牙紅蝦燴象拔蚌北海道海膽」皆主打鮮味。偉灝炒蝦殼期間香氣四溢，引得幟哥、「顧老闆」上前觀看。詠儀煮伊麵時獲幟哥指點可善用龍蝦湯，隨即「聽話」重做。這趟「廚師主理」強強對壘，會為比賽形勢帶來甚麼變化？

騙中傳奇#20粵PG
programme.desc: (大結局)太和殿內，玉麟搬出另一真「順」神像，忠正出現，百般侮辱玉麟，玉麟無奈將牙人身份退讓。忠正謂真神像真金不怕烘爐火，但神像竟被燒毀，和珅才知被忠正出賣。假神像內之滿文透露大清禍胎乃是和珅，嘉慶將和珅斬首。原來當天寶兒獻身給和珅，取得玉麟的解藥，免忠正被威脅。寶兒決定重新做人，而顧井亦發覺自己愛上了九斤二。玉麟誕下雙胞胎，九斤二亦答允下嫁顧井。嘉慶賜封忠正「天下第一牙」，讓他們永享福祿。

programme.title: 東張西望粵
programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 流行都市粵
programme.desc: 牙周病為何無法根治？牙醫指此症因清潔不當讓牙菌膜積聚所致，如嚴重會令牙肉與牙骨流失，並無法自然回復狀態。牙醫強調，牙周病或會影響身體其他地方的血管、增加認知障礙風險等。除了治療資訊，牙醫亦細說相關徵兆及預防方法。掌中木偶是非遺項目之一，有學校將它與中國歷史融合並向學生推廣。副校長概述木偶的製作過程，同來的學生分享學習過程苦與樂，還即席示範簡單的木偶動作。「睇餸食飯」，Annie奉上「話梅花雕蝦」。

programme.title: 拍檔廚房粵
programme.desc: 徐榮與曦雯在「五分鐘速煮」，分別帶來薑蔥魚雲、芝士煙肉燒生蠔，呈現中、西滋味。徐榮的家常魚菜式獲不俗評價，唯獨下調味料時有小失誤；曦雯的出品卻令幟哥不敢品嚐？詠儀、偉灝各自奉上的「上湯龍蝦伊麵」與「西班牙紅蝦燴象拔蚌北海道海膽」皆主打鮮味。偉灝炒蝦殼期間香氣四溢，引得幟哥、「顧老闆」上前觀看。詠儀煮伊麵時獲幟哥指點可善用龍蝦湯，隨即「聽話」重做。這趟「廚師主理」強強對壘，會為比賽形勢帶來甚麼變化？

programme.title: 大帥哥#12粵PG
programme.desc: 狄奇以軍法處罰沅婉三女，處罰對象令她們放棄隨軍。大軍出發後，三女遇到不祥預兆。狄奇、馬炭各自領軍突襲祿豐鎮，遇到伏擊。落蘆認定馬炭是少爺，堅持陪伴而受重傷。馬炭想起落蘆說過的軍事常識，成功製造爆炸；羅義中彈受傷，還看見三女來到，狄奇決定兵行險着……狄奇謊稱落蘆已死，引冬來說出真話。羅義緊張尋找丟失的軍帽，艾妞拾得軍帽，發現……馬炭建議狄奇趁機擴大版圖，狄奇訴說想法。英俊發帖邀請狄奇進餐……

programme.title: 高朋滿座#236粵
programme.desc: 義揭發情的「新男友」是德安，上前興師問罪。情道出安經已與父親反目，義不相信。義拉情回家，朋當眾宣布獲外國電視台聘請，當烹飪節目主持。言罷更向眾人表示將高家「話事人」的責任交予義，令義不敢說出情的事來。

programme.title: 說英雄誰是英雄#7粵普PG
programme.desc: 小石帶關七去找鶴發，怎料關七把鶴發的妻兒殺光，小石勸阻不果，懊悔不已。關七把想救人的小石綁住，夢枕和愁飛知道關七不好對付，便出計策讓雷損協助救人。關七在小石身上綁上炸藥並把他關在棺材裡，拖到宗書府中…

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 滕麗名、吳家樂、江欣燕、胡諾言替四位老友記拍攝沙龍，實現他們尚未完成的心願。阿滕和欣欣還親自為老友記化妝，還原他們的年輕美貌。鄂永城與太太劉寶添結婚數十載，一直自責欠老伴一個浪漫的求婚，適逢鑽婚紀念，他決定為愛妻補回甜蜜回憶。李煥紅重拾青春，只為拍攝一輯高貴大方的寫真，家樂與她前往設計髮型，完成造型一刻令她充滿驚喜。羅惠自小勤奮好學，主持帶她到訪舊式影樓，製作一張張夢寐以求的學生畢業照。

programme.title: 香港遊樂團粵
programme.desc: 滕麗名、吳家樂、江欣燕、胡諾言到訪「香港流浪狗之家」做義工，照顧廬內的328位「汪星人」。四位義氣仔女同是愛狗之人，打掃狗廬、替狗剪毛、洗澡當然義不容辭，可是也不時弄出「蝦碌」場面！狗兒愛跑愛跳，主持帶牠們乘坐狗巴士往野外舒展筋骨，以一次小型旅行建立可貴的人狗之情。三百多頭大、小狗兒同時開飯要隆重其事，狗廬每餐要準備多少狗糧侍候？欣欣、胡仔還嘗試替小狗餵藥，並帶牠們到動物診所看醫生。

programme.title: 香港早晨粵 及 環球新聞檔案粵
細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。

programme.title: M1 Group - Sports to the World呈獻：FIBA 3x3 世界巡迴賽—香港大師賽 2026直播粵 及 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 「FIBA 3x3 世界巡迴賽—香港大師賽 2026」，11月下旬於維多利亞公園上演。這項國際籃協最高級別的賽事，總獎金達一百萬港元，並雲集全球多地的頂尖隊伍，角逐王者寶座！TVB帶來焦點比拼，跟觀眾一同欣賞高水準、過程精彩刺激的三人籃球對壘。

programme.title: 警聲百二秒 IV粵
programme.desc: 《警聲百二秒 IV》引領觀眾「上天下海」、甚至「穿梭過去未來」，並繼續以輕鬆有趣的系列表達方式，讓市民接收豐富的警隊資訊，說好香港警察故事。

programme.title: 福祿壽訓練學院粵PG 及 AIA Vitality 健康程式特約：健康一分鐘粵
programme.desc: 分組對決首回合「復刻經典舞台」結束，羅冠蘭老師及現場觀眾仍然會為次回合「扮嘢電影短片」評分。福祿壽三隊分別以《孤寒戰》、《古域仔》、《福祿仇者聯盟》為題拍攝短片，祖藍為何被指有收買打分者之嫌？祥師兄的劇本獲冠蘭老師大讚創意高，能否追回落後分差？思捷隊的作品加入大量CG，以本傷人！第三回合「外景扮嘢挑戰」，參與師生到場才得悉任務內容，有人大失預算，也有人感慶幸……最終哪一組能夠有驚無險，全員晉級？

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: 雙祥見粵
programme.desc: 兩位祥哥教大家弄五青汁以及清血果汁，提倡健康飲食！二人更分享入行以來所見過藝人所犯的「死症」。MEN’S TALK環節則解構男人的壓力：主要從何而來? 又有咩減壓方法?

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更了解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的祢」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。

programme.title: 星光魔法粵日
programme.desc: 祭提出參加希娜的特訓，米露琪和檸檬亦一起參加，但兩人先後因不同緣故退出。見識到希娜的特訓有多嚴厲，讓祭重新審視自己對星光魔法的態度。臨參加迎新嘉年華之前，希娜表演最後一次星光魔法。

programme.title: Hands Up粵
programme.desc: 第一節「WORKOUT 2GETHER」針對協調能力做鍛練，連熱身動作也要講究協調性。體適能教練帶來四個動作，包括左右跳、單腳星星跳、原地跑交叉跳、雙腳跳起同時轉身，熟習後試將一系列動作串連起來，並不斷重覆做！第二節則是全身肌力訓練，需要用上橡筋帶。雙手以不同方式拉動橡筋帶，並留意呼吸節奏，過程中會練到全身的肌肉。最後換成二人一組，雙方前後腳站穩，同時把橡筋帶拉向自己，用力時亦要注意安全。

programme.title: 動物超能力粵英
programme.desc: 動物王國裡充滿了擁有超能力的不可思議生物！節目每一集會以不同的主題呈現，以及由不同領域的專家帶來令人震驚的知識作講解。

programme.title: 安妮的童話粵日
programme.desc: 菲莉帕來信向安妮透露自己對莊拿斯的心意，並為愛情苦惱。安妮回校後邂逅白馬王子羅伊，迅速展開浪漫交往。然而當羅伊表白成功後，她卻沒有預期中的感動，反而在晚宴上見到基爾伯特與克莉絲汀親近而心情複雜。

programme.title: 潮流生活誌之時尚頭條粵
programme.desc: 香港，一個中西薈萃、新舊共融的國際都市，不論吃喝、玩樂、購物都多姿多采。節目中主持人會介紹最新的潮流資訊和生活熱話，為你發掘香港更精彩的一面，講究生活和追求時尚的你絕對不能錯過。

programme.title: 六點半新聞報道粵
programme.desc: 翡翠台每日下午六點半，報道本地、兩岸及國際重要新聞。

programme.title: 好嘢港多啲粵
programme.desc: 香港特區政府帶領各個部門及單位，適時推出不同的政策措施，為本港市民、到訪旅客、來自外地的投資者提供便捷服務。香港這麼好，當然要多說一些讓大家知道。《好嘢港多啲》以輕鬆有趣的拍攝手法，配合陳豪、高海寧、張振朗、劉佩玥、周嘉洛、羅子溢、馬國明、陳懿德、陳展鵬、劉穎鏇等一眾星級藝員，透過不同角色、形象，生動地表達香港的各樣美好和優勢。

programme.title: 東張西望粵

programme.title: 飛常好聲音粵
programme.desc: 旨在尋找「飛常好聲音」的「航班」即將起飛，先有張與辰、張馳豪、朱敏瀚、吳偉豪以<I Found My Way準備啟航。八位在機場範圍擔任不同崗位的員工，簡介工作日常和職責之餘，也分別帶來一首自選歌。有選手湊巧地選擇星級評審張敬軒的<櫻花樹下，卻被軒公點評聲音似陳奕迅？周國豐難得稱讚某參賽者唱歌能力最強，但似乎揀錯歌？只有三位選手能登上第二回合的「班機」，要藉必殺歌盡情表現自己，並力爭最高名次！

programme.title: 東華三院善道同行粵
programme.desc: 東華三院服務惠及弱勢社群各種需要，醫院設先進儀器，為有身體機能障礙的病人安排復康治療。餐廳提供餐飲實習機會，助不同能力人士發揮所長。油尖旺區劏房戶齊聚「社區客廳」，可擴展生活空間，也獲身心支援。元朗過渡式房屋給予有需要人士一個家，大埔社區中心則關顧受影響的宏福苑家庭。東華也用心栽培下一代，「足球大使」獲專業訓練與海外交流機會，「學生大使」亦透過海外文化之旅增廣見聞。另搶先搜羅「東華」演出綵排花絮。

programme.title: 「雄」才論香港粵
programme.desc: 第一集，趙國雄與兩位嘉賓「德勤中國稅務與商務諮詢香港主管合夥人」劉明揚和「投資推廣署家族辦公室環球總裁」方展光，一起分析香港憑藉投資市場的多元化產品組合、稅務簡便，投資便捷以及「一國兩制」等有利條件，吸引了大量家族辦公室落戶。2025年底，香港有3,380個單一家族辦公室，與2023年底比較，已經是超過25%增長。家族辦公室透過直接營運開支，每年為香港經濟帶來超過126億的港元收益。

programme.title: 香港賽馬會特約：J Sport粵
programme.desc: 澳門格蘭披治大賽車圓滿舉行，現場氣氛熾熱，這集焦點重溫GT世界盃、F4世界盃的極速對決精華。香港公開羽毛球錦標賽結束，中國球手王祉怡衛冕女單冠軍，還會搜羅男雙、女雙、混雙的決賽戰報。結合街舞、滑板的嘉年華將於紅磡上演，運動員談及相關街頭運動變奧運項目的看法。無人機競速港隊將出戰世錦賽，五人團隊還迎來首位女將，送上誓師儀式花絮。乒乓球社區計劃啟動，港將黃鎮廷、杜凱琹、吳詠琳到訪校園，落場與學生交流。

programme.desc: 《東張西望》星期一至日，緊貼追蹤社會大事、趣聞逸事，並報道娛樂圈最新動態、藝人消息，以及劇集宣傳和花絮。「今日突發」環節為大家追蹤即日熱門新聞；專題環節，深入探討大眾關心的時事、社會及民生問題，並訪問相關的專家。

programme.title: 地球大神秘粵PG
programme.desc: 全新一輯《地球大神秘》，以探秘的角度及專業的手法，深入拆解世上各種不解謎團［Secret X］。［Secret X］代表未知、極致、禁忌，以及一切等待被發現真相的代號。透過揭開隱藏於挪亞方舟的終極奧秘，得以更了解貫穿世界一切事物的「神秘的祢」，從而在陷入亂局的這一刻，找到如何活得平安及豐盛，以及尋找到永恆不滅的主宰。

programme.title: 兄弟姊妹去旅行粵
programme.desc: 在瑞士坐巴士，下車前要按鐘，還要自行按掣開門？不如參觀交通博物館，認識更多當地的交通規則，還可大玩特玩多種遊戲，難怪阿蕭說想不到參觀博物館會咁攰！乘纜車登上皮拉圖斯山看雲海，不過挑戰繩網才是重點，原來繩網可令某人的強悍形象瞬間破壞，亦令阿廉這位「長者」頓變成「少女」傾慕的對象，子羚還提議他接拍《特技人2》擔任主角……的替身！在軌道上滑行過千米落山同樣刺激，換來速度感及滿足感，為何有人成為「笑柄」？

programme.title: 如果這樣生活粵PG
programme.desc: 李佳芯(Ali)用青春放手一搏，展開了不被看好的演藝路，就如這次西藏之旅，充滿歷險和未知。Ali踏單車從拉薩起步，途經村落小茶館與藏民同樂，親見神聖小布達拉宮，還入鄉隨俗看藏醫，怎麼被診斷出有「神經病」？經過驚險「108道拐」，Ali在珠穆朗瑪峰前，回想演藝路上的人情冷暖，到現在獲肯定，滿滿感動。Ali認識一位「樂天使者」，縱然半身癱瘓，但她的樂觀、瀟灑感染了Ali，還教Ali克服對滑雪的恐懼。

programme.title: 世界養生組織粵
programme.desc: 今時今日問10個人有什麼願望，9個人會答:身體健康！這些日子，疫症肆虐，人人都要增強抵抗力，才能與病毒共存；拉闊點看，人類平均壽命延長了，不好好保養自己等老了體弱多病的話，苦了自己也苦了家人，怎過意得去！

programme.title: 雙祥見粵
programme.desc: 兩位祥哥教大家弄五青汁以及清血果汁，提倡健康飲食！二人更分享入行以來所見過藝人所犯的「死症」。MEN’S TALK環節則解構男人的壓力：主要從何而來? 又有咩減壓方法?

programme.title: 香港本色粵
programme.desc: 蛋撻、菠蘿包、港式奶茶、鴛鴦等地道港式滋味的製作技藝，被列入非物質文化遺產名單。西環老字號茶餐廳負責人周錫豐製作蛋撻的經驗豐富，但他仍然認為製作過程非常困難，對他而言，哪個步驟最考工夫？「金茶王」冠軍級人馬梁德酬認為要沖出一杯靚奶茶，最重要是水滾茶靚，他大方分享沖茶技巧。另一位「金茶王」冠軍人馬林少昂，以沖調香港獨有的鴛鴦聞名，他曾參與美國交流活動，當中有何難忘經歷？

programme.title: 美食一條街 順德篇粵
programme.desc: 順德覓食之旅，由大良華蓋路步行街開始，大良燉奶有新花款，鄺潔楹對「首創」亦有新定義！倫教糕即白糖糕，加蛋煎製又有何新火花？拜訪順德網紅名廚，「魚羊鮮」和「岳母雞」令人難忘；走進由機械人主理的火鍋店，落單、送餐、甜品製作全智能化，眼界大開！還有另類「水晶料理」，莫非要把水晶吞入口中？即叫即燒的炭火燒雞與燒排骨，遠近馳名，三位哈比女主持都給予高評價。旅程尾聲一嚐混入黑米的煲仔飯，最讓人驚喜的卻是價格！

programme.title: 細味文明粵英
programme.desc: 遨遊全世界最受歡迎且充滿美態與魅力的旅遊勝地，欣賞美妙的天然奇景、引人入勝的古蹟、精湛的手工藝和迷人的景色。帶觀眾踏上難忘的旅程，融入夢想旅遊目的地的傳統與歷史裡。

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 夫婦的世界
programme.desc: 【閨蜜包庇老公偷吃！看正宮血洗渣男小三】醫院副院長池善雨擁有令人羨慕的完美生活，卻因一根神祕髮絲，驚覺導演丈夫早已出軌富家千金，且身邊摯友全都是幫忙隱瞞的幫兇。面對愛情與友情的雙重背叛，徹底心碎的她不再隱忍，決心化身復仇女神。她智商在線地精心設局，利用財產、孩子與社會地位作為籌碼，與丈夫展開一場玉石俱焚的心理戰與利益爭奪，將虛偽的婚姻面具狠狠撕碎。

programme.title: 絕妙的遺產
programme.desc: 【拒分遺產！為教訓貪財不孝子老父親再婚年輕單親媽】80歲的老闆夫英培，經營50年歷史的平壤冷麵老店，在一次睡夢中偶然靈魂出竅，4名兒子誤以為父親死亡，正在房外討論著如何分配爸爸的遺產。看著這些不成材的兒子們只想著財產，令夫英培非常痛心，醒來後打算將財產全數捐出，不料遭到基金會拒收。在一次偶然事件中，與30歲的單親媽媽孔桂玉相遇，並打算在兒子面前上演假結婚，當桂玉正式成為繼母後，兒子們慌了手腳，經過朝夕相處後，一家人克服了偏見，兒子們也不再覬覦遺產，而重新找回人生方向。

programme.title: 南風知我意
programme.desc: 【《蓮花樓》成毅在搭張予曦，再現《與君歌》絕美默契！！】藥物研發員傅雲深與外科醫生朱舊至偏鄉進行人道醫療救援，兩人從誤解到經歷生死危機而兩情相悅，彼此還不及坦承心意就遭逢巨變，從此斷絕聯繫。一年後的重逢，面對傅雲深的刁難與變化，朱舊堅韌及樂觀並不離不棄的守候，陪他度過每個春夏秋冬。

programme.title: 吹吧微風
programme.desc: 【千億遺產考驗林智妍淪落魄千金竟遭林秀香假冒身分】一場跨越南北的失散命運，意外揭開千億財產背後的血緣騙局。脫北女孩微風重返南韓，與多年不見的初戀律師長高重逢，卻被捲入豪門爭產與身世之謎。冒名孫女設局奪產，謊言層層堆疊，親情逐漸崩裂；長高的母親強勢介入，以門第與前途逼迫兒子放棄真愛。當真相一一曝光，有人為貪念付出慘痛代價，有人失去一切。被犧牲的愛情，是否還能在命運翻轉後，迎來真正的團圓？

programme.title: 魔女之城
programme.desc: 【婆媳小姑撕破臉！命運抓弄下的同居奇蹟】一場毀滅性的家庭變故，讓原本關係緊繃的離婚婆婆、媳婦與小姑，命運交織地被迫同住在一個屋簷下。撕下以往的對立標籤，三個性格迥異、傷痕累累的女人在滿是摩擦與衝突的日常中，漸漸看清彼此的脆弱。她們相互扶持、攜手抵禦人生的逆境風浪，最終走出陰霾，共築出比血緣更堅固的暖心情誼！

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 漢摩拉比小姐
programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 風起西州
programme.desc: 【《風起霓裳》最新續作！！許魏洲、古力娜扎續夫妻情緣，琴瑟和鳴的婚後生活及事業新考驗！！】製衣才女庫狄琉璃與裴行儉婚後面對大長公主的屢次使計刁難，琉璃聰慧應對，化險為夷。裴行儉因意外被貶遠赴西州上任，夫妻攜手同心，琉璃發揮自己的長才，傳授西州百姓製衣技巧。裴行儉則守護西州百姓經濟富足、安居樂業。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.desc: 【高雅羅×金明洙×成東鎰，三人三色法官個性，尋找法庭正義！！】三位個性截然不同的法官，在現實與理想間的掙扎與選擇。熱血直率的新任法官及冷靜理性的資深法官同事。每一場審判，都是對人性與制度的考驗。在案件背後，他們不只判案，更在學習如何面對自己心中的「正義」。

programme.title: 金裝律師
programme.desc: 【改編人氣美國影集，張東健×朴炯植聯手成為法律界黃金拍檔！！】頭腦聰明，擁有過目不忘天才能力的高延宇，卻因家境關係卻步成為律師。混進了律師事務所遇上韓國頂級資深律師崔江錫。隨著事件發生與時間相處成為黃金拍檔，崔江錫要如何亦師亦友的帶著沒有正式唸過大學也只是菜鳥律師的高延宇打出一片天下呢？

programme.title: 雙軌
programme.desc: 【何與×虞書欣偽骨科繼兄妹禁忌愛戀，從愛妹到曖昧火花四射！！】姜暮9歲前是被家人寵在手心的小女孩，靳朝是天之驕子的哥哥。那年父母離婚，兩人命運自此走上雙軌，爸爸和哥哥移居泰國，成為地下賽車與拳場中的修車工。多年後，19歲的姜暮得知哥哥是被領養的秘密，瞞著所有人獨自飛往泰國。在泰國的租屋中兩人展開了一段隱秘而甜蜜的情感旅程，在光明與黑暗間重逢，禁忌拉扯中雙向救贖。

programme.title: 冒險心星球

programme.title: 逆轉女王
programme.desc: 【經典韓劇《賢內助女王》姊妹作】黃泰熙原是高薪的開發組長，但為了追求幸福家庭，她選擇與新同事奉俊秀結婚。然而她的決定，卻讓她被信任的女上司趕出公司，只能在家當賢內助。五年後，泰熙感到現實生活的沉重，決定重返職場。在公司她遇見了具勇植，一位支持她的本部長。泰熙在勇植的鼓勵下展現出更堅韌的一面，最終成功東山再起，找到了新的事業目標。

programme.title: 等待京道(完)
programme.desc: 【朴敘俊回歸攜手《魷魚2》元志安《等待京道》譜十年宿命戀】十年後的重逢，讓李京道與徐智友再度陷入愛情的漩渦。曾是彼此初戀的兩人，如今一個是追尋真相的記者，一個是醜聞風暴中的名門繼承人。再見面時，他們早已不是年少時的模樣，卻依然在對方身上看見過去的自己。愛情與現實的距離，在一次次試探與退讓間拉扯，他們明知前方滿是荊棘，仍選擇再次並肩。

programme.title: 男朋友
programme.desc: 【韓版《羅馬假期》霸總宋慧喬戀上暖男朴寶劍】出身政客家庭的車秀賢，為了家族犧牲愛情、步入無愛的婚姻，離婚後的人生空虛蒼白；金振赫是懷抱夢想的平凡青年，用熱情擁抱世界。兩人在異國邂逅，相知相愛，卻因身分懸殊而痛苦分離。多年後重逢，她已是冷靜自持的上司，他是剛入職的新進員工。過往的甜蜜與傷痕浮現，情感再度悄然蔓延。她掙扎於曾經的選擇，他則努力衝破階級的枷鎖。愛情，能否再次在現實的夾縫中綻放？

programme.title: 我親愛的朋友們
programme.desc: 【老人也有春天！七十歲的我們 終於學會說不】她們是一群走過風雨的老人，曾為家庭默默奉獻，如今選擇為自己綻放。一場聚會重新牽起年少情誼，也掀開多年壓抑的心事。有人鼓起勇氣離婚，搬進夢想中的小屋；有人在意外後學會面對過錯，重拾友情的信任；有人對抗失智，卻仍記得朋友的名字與笑聲。女兒朴莞在傾聽中理解母親，在書寫中記錄她們的光芒。人生未晚，她們手牽著手，用皺紋寫下溫柔，也用笑聲走向嶄新的旅程。

programme.title: 只屬於我的你
programme.desc: 【渣男律師劈腿富豪千金李敏英逆襲成知名設計師】恩靜與律師姜勝宰結婚後，原以為會享受奢華生活，但現實卻是在婆家被當成傭人使喚。婆婆因恩靜沒有家世而感到丟臉，勝宰也漸漸冷淡，甚至不願承認老婆。事實上，恩靜發現勝宰根本沒有辦理結婚登記，當她為了幫助妹妹處理財務問題，辦理貸款時才揭露了這個真相。不久後她發現老公與BJ集團繼承人有染，決心離開傷心地，重返職場成為知名設計師。與此同時，昔日男友俊夏重新進入她的生活，默默支持她，希望能給她真正的幸福。

programme.title: 女醫明妃傳
programme.desc: 【劉詩詩淡妝出鏡美出新高度，妙手仁心成明朝一代女國醫！！】女子地位低下的大明，不得從醫也難治隱疾。杭允賢從小耳濡目染，偷偷隨祖母學習中醫知識，不僅在學醫道路上面臨重重的困難和阻礙，更要面對封建禮教和世俗觀念的衝擊。開創並建立女醫制度，從救人身體到救人靈魂，懸壺濟世、妙手仁心的名聲，得到普通百姓的讚揚和支持。

programme.title: 裝腔啟示錄
programme.desc: 初級律師唐影在上海紅圈律所工作，意外結識了合作方許子詮。雖然二人暗生情愫，卻始終沒有勇氣直面真實的情感。兩人歷經多次事件，最終在唐影的幫助下，許子詮驅散了多年陰影，敢於直面情感不再逃避，而唐影也在許子詮的信任和陪伴下，接受了自己最真實的一面。

programme.title: 完全省錢戀愛手冊
programme.desc: 【精打細算的戀愛，郭書瑤vs林子閎金錢價值觀保衛戰，有錢沒錢都要愛！！】不追求戀愛的節儉會計師上班族簡可可，平易近人做事俐落、個性率直又善良。碰上了花錢如流水的同事王海闊，是能力強、業界有名的王牌業務。對彼此逐漸動心的愛情，兩人的金錢價值觀卻大大不同，要如何在愛情與麵包做選擇呢?

programme.title: 九尾狐傳
programme.desc: 【人間九尾狐李棟旭苦等初戀大談人狐千年禁忌戀！！】活在現代的九尾狐李硯，身兼著閻羅王姐姐的陰間使者指令，斬妖除魔苦苦等候初戀南智雅轉世千年在今生相遇，做為半人半妖的同父異母弟弟李朗，頻頻與李硯作對攪局。過去親情、愛情、友情的磨難及錯誤的種子，在此世會得到解答嗎?

programme.title: 我把社長解鎖了
programme.desc: 【人氣網漫改編，影帝朴星雄解密手機AI的技術奇幻職場劇！】國內市占率最高的科技公司創辦人天才CEO金成柱，因突發事件被殺手追殺成了謀殺案受害者，靈魂尚未離開人世而換個方式存活在剛大學畢業出社會朴仁成的手機內。為找出死亡的真相以及守住公司的一切，成了代理的CEO開始兩人的合作。

OMRON 血压测量仪，一次测量即可获得血压和心律分析。通过Omron的智能算法，分析脉搏律动，帮助用户及早发现潜在心房颤动风险。心房颤动风险是脉搏间隔不规律的现象，提早发现有助于降低中风的风险。居家也能轻松监测心脏健康。

programme.desc: A comprehensive eye nutrition formula designed to support daily eye health from multiple angles. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Pan-American Highway, Panama
programme.desc: The team's Pan-American road trip leads them to discover that Glitch is building a road through the Darien Gap. Can they save this important habitat and protect the local sloths?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Teasing
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. As they recall all the times where he's been a Big Teaser, Dad argues that he was only just playing.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Sticky Gecko
programme.desc: Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Velociraptor
programme.desc: When Andy loses his gizmo and gets lost in the dark, a friendly velociraptor comes to his aid.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Tambourine
programme.desc: Bella and Lift play a fun game in Playtime Towers, but who can find the musical instrument that makes a shaky drum sound? It's a tambourine!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Brave Banana Badge
programme.desc: A big dark cloud hovers over the clubhouse and a storm begins. It turns out the squirrels are scared of lightning! Fortunately, Duggee has his Brave Banana Badge, so he knows exactly how to help them overcome their fears.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Sleeping Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have had an exhausting morning playing. After their milk they can have their nap. Lovely...but Tag can't sleep! Don't worry, Duggee can help, he has his Sleeping Badge and can offer a few tricks to get to sleep.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Island Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. What fun! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick Duggee suggests a stop off at the Island for a spot of lunch, but where's all the food?

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Kinderdijk, Netherlands
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to Kinderdijk in The Netherlands to celebrate National Mill Day.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - The Leshan Giant Buddha, China
programme.desc: The Go Jetters master the art of mindfulness to save the Giant Buddha of Leshan in China.

programme.title: Thomas & Friends S24 - Yong Bao and the Tiger
programme.desc: Yong Bao tells Thomas the story of how he cleverly diverted an accident, saving hundreds of passengers and was decorated for his bravery with a tiger emblem on his tender and a bright red coat of paint.

programme.title: Nikhil & Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Cuppa King﻿
programme.desc: Nikhil and Jay help Appa get ready for his appearance on Mr Awan's channel, so that he can tell the world about his amazing Appa Cuppa! Can they help Appa overcome his camera shyness?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Library Book
programme.desc: Stanley must track down the missing library book, 'The Little Book of New Things to Do'. He visits various townsfolk who have leant the book to each other.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Treasure
programme.desc: Morris and Pearl have lost one of their medals in the canal. Stanley fishes it out only have the complete collection dropped in. Stanley dons a diver's suit and goes after them.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I'm Not Even Scared of Nothing
programme.desc: Werewolves, cobras, alligators, and commando dragons! The animals chat about all the things which absolutely do not make them scared.

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran S01 - It's time for a special visitor
programme.desc: There's a family get together when Great Gran Gran comes to visit from St. Lucia. JoJo has a whole day of activities planned, but she learns that it's not what you do that makes a day special, it's who you spend it with.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Curry Quest
programme.desc: Bingo and Dad must brave a swooping magpie protecting its nest, when they go on a curry swap to Mackenzie's house through the park.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Organising Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels are playing in the Clubhouse. Roly is trying to force a very large plastic ball into the bin, but it flies out and crashes into a tower that Betty has built. The squirrels decide it is time to tidy up. Luckily Duggee has his Organising Badge, and with the help of the Squirrels they reorganize everything in the clubhouse. Once finished they head outside... but how best to organise the animals?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Grandparents Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the squirrels are tidying up - its Bring your Grandparents to Squirrel Club Day. Duggee has his Grandparents badge so he knows what they will like, a nice cup of tea. But on arrival, these Grandparents seem more of a lively bunch than Duggee was expecting! Tag's Gran parachutes in from a plane and Norrie's Gran is a biker and arrives on her motorbike! Once in the clubhouse they launch into Show & Tell. These Grandparents have some GREAT stories to share!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Mystery Seeds
programme.desc: When Duggee finds some seeds it's time for some gardening!

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Ambulance
programme.desc: Maisy and Charley help Eddie in their ambulance.

programme.title: My Friend Maisy S01 - Flying Party
programme.desc: Maisy flies her plane, and her friends join for a party in the sky.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Avocado
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's the fabulous Avocados singing an operatic piece in their three unique voices.

programme.title: Roots & Fruits S02 - Banana
programme.desc: Live from the Roots and Fruits theatre, it's Banana revealing yet another astonishing secret about herself in the opera piece, "I've Got a Secret"

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Carrot's Big Top
programme.desc: Carrot is starring in a circus, but problems arise when Evil Pea meddles with her tricks.

programme.title: Supertato S01 - Undercover Tomato
programme.desc: Tomato paints himself green and goes undercover as a Mini Pea to discover how Evil Pea is firing them at Tato Tower. He makes an unexpected new Mini Pea friend.

programme.title: Teletubbies S01 - Honk Honk
programme.desc: The Teletubbies hear a 'honk honk' in the distance and the Tubby Car approaches. The Tubby Car drives the Teletubbies across Teletubbyland as they sing the Tubby Car song.

programme.desc: Dee encourages a friend to say `hedgehog', and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. Today we meet lots of hedgehogs: a brown hedgehog, a small hedgehog, a snuffling hedgehog and a hungry hedgehog.

programme.desc: Lucky's Dad is outraged that modern Pass the Parcel has a present in every layer and changes the rules back to only having one prize in the middle, but Bingo is forever losing.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Housework
programme.desc: Mum and Dad vow to only finish their boring housework when the kids stop acting silly, but that's never going to happen, so they end up trying the same approach themselves.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Metal Detector Badge
programme.desc: It's a lovely day, so everyone is playing outside. Things take a turn when Roly needs a wee, because the door is locked and Duggee has mislaid the key. The Squirrels start looking around for it, but they have no luck. Not to worry, Duggee has his metal detector, Helen. After demonstrating it to the Squirrels, they are very keen to give it a go.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S05 - The Diary Badge
programme.desc: The day starts when Duggee moves a cupboard, and the Squirrels find a dusty, old book behind it. It's Duggee's diary from when he was a teenager! The Squirrels aren't sure what a diary is, so Duggee explains by reading some extracts. The Squirrels are keen to write diaries of their own.

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Squirrel Babies
programme.desc: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

programme.title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club S01 - Song of Peace
programme.desc: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

programme.title: Go Jetters S03 - Pan-American Highway, Panama
programme.desc: The team's Pan-American road trip leads them to discover that Glitch is building a road through the Darien Gap. Can they save this important habitat and protect the local sloths?

programme.title: Bluey S01 - Teasing
programme.desc: Bluey, Bingo and Mum get into a debate with Dad about the definition of teasing. As they recall all the times where he's been a Big Teaser, Dad argues that he was only just playing.

programme.title: Bluey S02 - Sticky Gecko
programme.desc: Mum must get Bluey and Bingo out the door in time for a playdate, but they can't leave before they finish their game - waiting for a sticky rubber gecko to drop from the ceiling.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Ragdoll
programme.desc: Dad agrees to take Bluey and Bingo to the shops to buy an ice-cream if they can get him into the car. Only problem is... he's just entered 'Ragdoll' mode!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Fairy Tale
programme.desc: Dad tells Bluey and Bingo a real-life fairy tale about growing up in a wild place called the '80s, about a boy who was cursed when he was mean to his little brother.

programme.title: Andy's Dino Island S01 - Andy and the Velociraptor
programme.desc: When Andy loses his gizmo and gets lost in the dark, a friendly velociraptor comes to his aid.

programme.title: Playtime Towers S01 - Tambourine
programme.desc: Bella and Lift play a fun game in Playtime Towers, but who can find the musical instrument that makes a shaky drum sound? It's a tambourine!

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Brave Banana Badge
programme.desc: A big dark cloud hovers over the clubhouse and a storm begins. It turns out the squirrels are scared of lightning! Fortunately, Duggee has his Brave Banana Badge, so he knows exactly how to help them overcome their fears.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Sleeping Badge
programme.desc: The squirrels have had an exhausting morning playing. After their milk they can have their nap. Lovely...but Tag can't sleep! Don't worry, Duggee can help, he has his Sleeping Badge and can offer a few tricks to get to sleep.

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Island Badge
programme.desc: Duggee and the Squirrels are out doing a bit of sailing. What fun! When Tag starts to feel a little bit seasick Duggee suggests a stop off at the Island for a spot of lunch, but where's all the food?

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - Kinderdijk, Netherlands
programme.desc: The Go Jetters travel to Kinderdijk in The Netherlands to celebrate National Mill Day.

programme.title: Go Jetters S02 - The Leshan Giant Buddha, China
programme.desc: The Go Jetters master the art of mindfulness to save the Giant Buddha of Leshan in China.

programme.title: Thomas &amp; Friends S24 - Yong Bao and the Tiger

programme.title: Nikhil &amp; Jay S01 - Nikhil and Jay and the Cuppa King﻿
programme.desc: Nikhil and Jay help Appa get ready for his appearance on Mr Awan's channel, so that he can tell the world about his amazing Appa Cuppa! Can they help Appa overcome his camera shyness?

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Library Book
programme.desc: Stanley must track down the missing library book, 'The Little Book of New Things to Do'. He visits various townsfolk who have leant the book to each other.

programme.title: Stan Can S01 - Treasure
programme.desc: Morris and Pearl have lost one of their medals in the canal. Stanley fishes it out only have the complete collection dropped in. Stanley dons a diver's suit and goes after them.

programme.title: Funny Talking Animals S01 - I'm Not Even Scared of Nothing

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Mini Bluey
programme.desc: When Dad complains about how dissimilar Bluey and Bingo are, Bluey hatches a plan to make them more alike and happily introduces Mini-Bluey!

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Unicorse
programme.desc: Bluey can't get to sleep, so Mum reads her one last story. But they are interrupted by Unicorse, the most annoying hand puppet in the world, whom Bluey tries to reform.

programme.title: Bluey S03 - Curry Quest

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Organising Badge

The squirrels decide it is time to tidy up. Luckily Duggee has his Organising Badge, and with the help of the Squirrels they reorganize everything in the clubhouse. Once finished they head outside... but how best to organise the animals?

programme.title: Hey Duggee S02 - The Grandparents Badge

Once in the clubhouse they launch into Show &amp;amp; Tell. These Grandparents have some GREAT stories to share!

programme.title: The Winged Tiger
programme.desc: If the two big villains Winged Tiger and Underworld King join forces, the martial arts world will be plunged into chaos. This evil union is set to occur with the marriage of the Underworld King's sister and the Winged Tiger. Can this dangerous duo be stopped before one says "I do"?

programme.title: Fast Fingers
programme.desc: After his release from prison, Uncle Bill returns to make a fortune with his past thieving partners. They continue to prey on the unsuspecting public, but are closely watched by the upright police chief, who happens to be the boyfriend of one of Uncle Bill's nieces!

programme.title: The Rebel Intruders
programme.desc: Thousands of displaced refugees rush to the southern towns to avoid the civil war in north China. Three such young men trained with martial arts skills become sworn brothers, and accidentally got involved in the battle of the rebel leaders in town when they save a refugee girl. Can they fight back against the rebel gangs?

programme.title: What Price Honesty
programme.desc: Three rookie constables refuse to collude with corrupt officials, making themselves targets of a deadly conspiracy. After losing comrades and witnessing the abuse of power, they abandon all hope of justice. Determined to avenge the fallen, they launch a bloody assault on the corrupt forces in a desperate fight for justice.

programme.title: A Taste Of Cold Steel
programme.desc: Gan Dai Xiong is killed by Prince Wu, who seeks to seize his Purple Sword. Prince Wu's son join forces with an evil gang to steal the Purple Sword from Gan Dai Xiong's three daughters. Eventually, Gan's daughters team up with their cousin Xu to avenge their father's death.

programme.title: Mission Impossible
programme.desc: A sword master's daughter is pursued and poisoned by an evil master when bringing back the stolen Golden Sword to the palace. She dies on the run and returns as a spirit to take revenge by killing the evil master, and soon vanishes after returning the sword to the emperor.

programme.title: Love without End(1961)
programme.desc: In this classic romantic melodrama, nightclub songstress Qing Qing falls for the handsome Peng Nan. However, the two go through an emotional roller coaster of misunderstandings, separations and mutual torment. When the two finally fall back into love, Qing Qing receives a shocking revelation that brings the story to its inevitable sad ending.

programme.title: The Shadow Boxing
programme.desc: Chan and his apprentice Fan transport zombies for a living and are hired to move nine zombies in one go. When two hop away, it is revealed that one is actually a man in disguise trying to escape his enemies. It turns out that both the disguised zombie and Chan are martial arts experts!

programme.title: Family Light Affair
programme.desc: Alfred Cheung Kin-ting returns to the screen with this seriocomic look at the clash of cultures which result when a Mainland Chinese peasant brings his family to Hong Kong. Family Light Affair, whose Chinese title literally translates as "City Lights", is the directorwriter's warm-hearted memoir of street life back in the early 1980s, featuring an eclectic cast of pop music and kung fu stars who shine in their poignant roles.

programme.title: The Twelve Gold Medallions
programme.desc: Chancellor Qin Hui forges twelve gold medallions to recall General Yue Fei from the war's front line. Swordsman Miao Lung leads heroes to intercept them, only to find their leader is his mentor, Jin Yan Tang. Torn between loyalty and duty, the two clash in a duel. Miao Lung wrests the medallions, but cannot avert history's tragedy.

programme.title: Call of the Sea
programme.desc: A young fisherman, Chin Hu is in love with his childhood friend Hsiao Yu. However, the only son of a town bully lusts after Hsiao Yu's beauty and tries all possible ways to approach her. Chin Hu protects another woman from the bully one day, leading Hsiao Yu to misunderstand him and suspect that they are having an affair...

programme.title: The Secret Of The Dirk
programme.desc: The inhabitants of the City of Liu are forced to flee when the vicious Black Tigers gang raids their city, but are able to hide all their gold and treasures in a valley. A team of swordswomen led by Liu wants to get their hands on the treasures before the bandits, but both parties will have to contend with the wandering swordsman Chou for them...

programme.title: My Son
programme.desc: Kuo, a police's son, blames his father for his mother's death. He has no job, spends time in night clubs and always gets into fights. One night, Kuo rescues Mei from being raped and they become friends. Kuo wants to support Mei and her family so he goes gambling hoping to gain more money but bad luck seems to be following them with tragic outcomes.

programme.title: Vengeance
programme.desc: Yu Lou is betrayed by his wife and eventually killed by her lover, Fung, who is the boss of a martial arts school. Yu Lou's brother, Xiao Lou, knows about his tragic death and is determined to take revenge for him.

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: The Crazy Bumpkins
programme.desc: This side-splitting comedy sees naive Ah Niu headed to Hong Kong, where he is repeatedly exploited and taken advantage of, and eventually finds himself arrested and imprisoned! Can he survive difficult times and finally overcome adversity?

programme.title: Five Shaolin Masters
programme.desc: The Qing court plots to kill all Shaolin disciples by burning down Shaolin Temple. This sudden fire killed almost everyone except for five disciples. To take revenge on the Qing court, the five of them train hard in different fighting styles to become “The Five Shaolin Masters”.

programme.title: King Drummer
programme.desc: A young musician Chi Chiang is hired by the manager of a popular band when the group's drummerleader Charlie, quits to join a rival group. The new drummer becomes an immediate hit, causing Charlie to be very jealous. Furthermore, the young drummer's mother is dead set against him having a music career.

programme.title: Heroes Shed No Tears
programme.desc: Kao Chien Fei is a young swordsman who wields a special sword with a teardrop marked on its blade. He is charged with averting an impending crisis in the martial arts world, but the villain, Zhou Tung Lai, wishes to become the ruler in the martial arts world, and launches a scheme to pit the various heroes against one another.

programme.title: Tropicana Interlude
programme.desc: Wealthy heir Ping Chien Jen spurns the family business for a travel agency with his girlfriend Su Yung Lan. While they are hosting visitors from Hong Kong, a student falls for Chien Jen, sparking tension. Consumed by jealousy, Yung Lan storms off, and the student crashes her car after learning of his engagement. Misunderstandings are eventually cleared, and happiness follows.

programme.title: The Iron Buddha
programme.desc: After a notorious rapist Xiao kills his master and the entire clan, Han the last surviving disciple, decides to take revenge. He must find the legendary Hulong Blade to counter Xiao's Evil Poisonous Sword, but as Han has never seen Xiao before, he is deceived when Xiao poses as an ally to try and steal his Blade in the process.

programme.title: The Big Sting
programme.desc: Three buddies find a rare artifact known as the Double-Faced God but are poisoned by Lady Wu who steals the treasure from them. Before they die, they get their wives to promise to train their children to take back what is rightfully theirs. These kids grow up to exact a vengeance that turns out to be more hilarious than horrific in this comedy.

programme.title: Killers Five
programme.desc: The Duke's daughter has been kidnapped by the notorious Golden Dragon Hill bandits. A swordman named Yue Zhen Bei is assigned to save her, and expecting many dangers on the journey, Yue garners help from a group of good friends who are also kung fu masters.

programme.title: The Butterfly Chalice
programme.desc: In the Ming Dynasty, scholar Tian Yu Chuan defends a fisherman's honour but accidentally kills the governor's son, driving him into exile. Pursued to the river's edge, he is rescued by the fisherman's daughter. Amid danger, love blossoms between them, and Tian seals their bond with his family heirloom, the Butterfly Chalice.

programme.title: The Proud Youth
programme.desc: Ling Hu Chong, a Huashan clan's disciple, is assigned to find the successor to the score “The Proud One”. Ling identifies Ying for the score but finds out that she is the daughter of the evil clan's leader. At the same time, he is unwittingly dragged into an epic power struggle between clans, with complicated allegiances and perplexing moralities.

programme.title: Sweet And Wild
programme.desc: Fang is a spunky young village girl who is not afraid to fight back against hooligans. She gets into trouble with the biggest hoodlum Tong when she foils his plans with a maid, causing Tong to plot a revenge. Luckily a man whom she is attracted to, Hai, comes in time to her rescue. Can they fight back?

programme.title: The Reckless Cricket
programme.desc: Inspired by “Drunken Master”, this kung fu comedy features a bumbling martial artist creating a cricket-style fighting arts to fight and defeat the different martial artists who have beaten him before.

programme.title: The Last Tempest
programme.desc: This sequel to The Empress Dowager continues the tale of Emperor Guangxu and Empress Dowager Cixi. Despite Guangxu's enthronement, his ability to rule effectively is overshadowed by the ever-present power of Cixi. When his attempts to reform the Imperial system are thwarted by the Empress Dowager, Guangxu attempts to curb her power.

programme.title: The Land of Many Perfumes
programme.desc: Monk Tang San Zang, Monkey, Pigsy and Sha Wu Jing find themselves in Womanland, where women only give birth to baby girls and do so by drinking the magical spring water.

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: Melody of Love
programme.desc: Three young doctors pursue three hard-to-get beauties in this romantic film set in the 70s “a-go-go” era. They have no idea where to start and use Rock-paper-scissor method to match themselves with the girls. The tactics and tricks they use are hilarious and they have to reshuffle their plans when nothing leads to success!

programme.title: The Brave Archer
programme.desc: On his way back to the midlands, Guo Jing meets Huang Rong and they quickly fall in love. However, Ouyang Ke proposes to marry Huang Rong at the same time, so Huang's father sets up a duel for the two men to compete for her hand. Guo Jing finally beats Ouyang Ke to win Huang Rong back.

programme.title: The Shepherd Girl
programme.desc: In this musical drama, Hsiu Hsiu, a beautiful shepherd girl, falls in love with a handsome boatman Ta Lung. However, she cannot afford to marry him because of her father's towering debt from gambling. To complicate the matter, a rival suitor promises to pay off all her father's debts on one condition: that Hsiu Hsiu marries him...

programme.title: Super Inframan
programme.desc: Transformed from a young laboratory researcher, the thunderbolt-fisted Inframan must battle Princess Dragon Mom who wakes up from hibernation to conquer the earth with her army of mutant monsters.

programme.title: The Bride from Hell
programme.desc: Fang Ming marries the mysterious young lady Leng Qiu Ping, only to discover she is a spirit forced to drain men's life essence. With a Taoist's help, he frees her from an evil force, but their love cannot cross life and death, and they part at dawn in a bittersweet farewell.

programme.title: The Heroic Ones
programme.desc: Set in the Tang Dynasty, the 13 adopted sons of Sha Tuo King are all renowned as royal warriors. David Chiang plays the 13th Prince, a powerful fighter whose prestigious status provokes jealously, leading to a gruesome family feud.

programme.title: The Anonymous Heroes
programme.desc: Carefree drifters Meng Gang and Tie Hu discover their purpose after meeting the revolutionary leader, Wan Tai. With the help of Meng Gang's girlfriend, they infiltrate a warlord camp to seize weapons for the revolutionary cause. Following a fierce battle, all three make the ultimate sacrifice, becoming the "Anonymous Heroes" of the revolution.

programme.title: Swordsman at Large
programme.desc: Hsiao Shi Yi Lang is the Swordsman at large who everyone wants to kill. A magnificient sword is even created for this purpose though the blade is soon coveted more than the swordsman's death by it! Bandits, beauties and blade masters battle for survival in this exciting story of deceit, betrayal, and death.

programme.title: The Protectors
programme.desc: Ling Hsiao and Kuan Wang Lung are two guard chiefs working for an old convoy master. Lung is secretly in love with Fang Yen, the master's granddaughter but Yen is attracted to Ling Hsiao instead. In order to win her back, Lung sets up a trap to steal the convoy and frames Ling Hsiao for it.

programme.title: Tragic Commitment
programme.desc: When the husband of a doctor, Tung is fatally wounded in an accident, he reveals to her about his affair with Blackie, who is impregnated with his baby. Despite the devastation of the betrayal and the eventual death of her husband, Tung is pressured by her mother-in-law into putting up with Blackie and offer $1M for her baby...

programme.title: Trilogy Of Swordsmanship
programme.desc: A kung fu anthology film consisting of three stories: a man embarrasses himself while trying to prove his worth to the father of the woman he loves; a courtesan in love with a general will need to deliver a notorious bandit in exchange for him not being executed; and a group of bandits forms a plan to rescue a new friend from being executed.

programme.title: The Bells of Death
programme.desc: Wei Fu is an unremarkable woodcutter. However, when psychotic marauders killed his family and abducted his sister, he goes through vigorous martial arts training with an expert swordsman in order to exact revenge on the evildoers.

programme.title: The Supreme Swordsman
programme.desc: After beating several famous swordsmen, Chin Wu Hsin of the Mo Shan clan challenges Supreme Swordsman to a duel, hoping to win his title, and is beaten and humiliated. The winner taunts him to find a Supreme Sword made by Old Eagle, a famous sword-maker. When his offer to buy a sword from Old Eagle, is turned down, he challenges Old Eagle to a duel, and snatches his sword in a foul play. Old Eagle's own son Shih Yen-peh vows to avenge for his father...

programme.title: A Friend from Inner Space
programme.desc: A young boy whose parents are separated tries to find happiness in life. One day, he meets and befriends a kind-hearted spirit Ren, who decides to make him truly happy by getting his parents back together.

programme.title: Shaolin Prince
programme.desc: Two royal brothers are separated as babies after a traitorous general usurps the throne. Raised apart, one within Shaolin Temple and the other by a noble lord, they grow into formidable martial artists. When destiny reunites them, the brothers must combine their deadly kung fu styles to overthrow the tyrant and avenge their fallen empire.
